title: Friend Mike secretly watched Buer and Drew race independently

tellings.quote: He knew about us working on this independently for years and never told us, never did.

plain: Charles Buhler, presented on the show as a NASA chief who says his team has built antigravity propulsion, says that around 2016 in Florida a friend of his named Mike knew that Buhler and a man named Andrew Arjima had each been working on the same thing, separately, for years. Buhler, who was one of the two, tells Michels that Mike watched them both and never said a word: "He knew about us working on this independently for years and never told us, never did." If it happened that way, two people were racing toward the same goal without knowing it, and someone in between was keeping it quiet.
